about: The Awakened Pack (docs/plan-pack.html). Edit this file, then run tools/pack.py lock to pin exact files.

profiles.perf: Frame rate and memory. Client-side except Lithium and FerriteCore.
profiles.feel: Camera, limbs, the animation library Awaken's full-body casts use, and Fresh Animations for vanilla creature bodies.
profiles.sound: Room acoustics and the world's nature ambience (AmbientSounds); AWAKEN's own world sound is in the mod.
profiles.comfort: Recipe lookup, block info and inventory help. The world map is Awaken's own Atlas (M); no minimap, by design.
profiles.ultra: Experimental: Iris shaders (OpenGL only; Iris lists Apple Silicon as unsupported).
profiles.world: New terrain (Tectonic). Only ever installed into a fresh game folder (tools/play.sh --pack): it would seam existing worlds.
profiles.soundspike: World sound spike only (docs/sound/PLAN.md §11): Tread Lightly and Immersive Thunder Reforged beside Sound Physics. Never installed by tools/play.sh.

mods.why: Faster chunk rendering. 0.9.3-beta.1: 0.9.2 crashes on NeoForge 26.3.0.95 (LevelExtractor mixin, 2026-10-24).
Faster game logic on the integrated server.
Less memory, which matters on 16 GB.
Faster HUD, text and entity drawing.
Skips entities and block entities you can't see.
Culls more block faces (leaves).
Throttles the game in the background: a cooler laptop. Never in perf runs: it stops drawing while the window is hidden, so a background measurement records no frames.
Terrain to the horizon.
Mountain ranges, deep oceans and valleys; keeps vanilla biomes, so every Awaken spawn and ruin still has a home.
Full-body cast animations (optional for Awaken).
Bent knees and elbows: renders the bend the Player Animation Library's clips carry (same author). Client only.
Camera roll and sway that give movement weight.
Over-the-shoulder third person (F5 cycles to it): shows the body's full-body move clips. Client only.
Third-person limbs for eating, climbing, maps.
3D skin layers: players read as people in co-op.
Entity Model Features: runs Fresh Animations' models and animations on vanilla creature bodies. Client only. Awaken's own bodies have no .jem models, so it leaves them alone (SPEC §23).
Entity Texture Features: EMF's partner (blinking, emissive and variant textures). Client only.

Resource pack: livelier vanilla creatures (breathing, blinking, weight, idle fidgets), and our gate monsters on vanilla bodies with them. Needs EMF and ETF. Our own bodies get Awaken's life layer instead (SPEC §23).
Reverb and echo in halls and caves.

Nature ambience for every biome (Euan, 2026-10-25: use the mod that already does this well); the city's own zones (gulls over the river, owls, doves, garden birds, wind on the roofs) reference its sounds by id (SPEC §16.0 decision 30). AWAKEN's Conductor plays the magic and places and lowers it under AWAKEN's moments (compat.client.AmbientSoundsBridge); our jar mutes it in awaken: dimensions.
Recipe lookup.
What am I looking at.
Food values.
Inventory dragging.
Searchable key binds.
Share a single-player world by link.
Proximity voice.
Shaderpacks, experimental. 1.11.7 pins Sodium 0.9.2, which crashes on NeoForge 26.3.0.95: Ultra waits for an Iris update.
Profiler for frame and tick spikes.
Footsteps by surface, wetness and boots (world sound decision 2); joins the sound profile once the spike passes.
Thunder delayed by distance; replaces our own thunder re-voicing if the spike is clean.

configs.why: The Awakened Tectonic preset (Awakened Lands studio): continents with real ranges, less sea. Tectonic reads it once at startup.

Keeps the System's voice, the UI, the music (cues, tracks, layered stems) and the Ritual's scripted voices dry; everything else of Awaken's gets the room it is in. SPR adds every other sound event to the file on its first start.
